title: Paper storm
technique: Thousands of copies of a printed sheet are placed and turned by one shader that arranges them into formations.
music: The bar turns the rings of paper and the beat flips sheets and changes the board's page. Each kick drum sends a shockwave ring through the paper that throws and tips what it passes, and a ring of sheets turning to black leaves the middle of the floor every two beats.

takes.name: Board
takes.description: A flat wall of sheets seen square-on, where sheets turned to their yellow reverse spell short three-line phrases in pixel letters and a new phrase flaps in every two beats.
words: EVERY SHEET IS A PIXEL OF THIS TEXT
KICK DRUM SENDS A RING OUT

takes.name: Floor
takes.description: A view straight down on a tidy floor of printed sheets drawn in chunky black-and-white pixels, where a ring of sheets turning to black spreads out every two beats.
words: INSTANCING: A FLOOR OF 6144 SHEETS, DRAWN IN 1-BIT DITHER.
EVERY 2 BEATS A RING OF SHEETS TURNS OVER TO BLACK.

takes.name: Oculus
takes.description: A view from inside a dome looking up through rings of paper turning against each other, whose blue reverses carry a short phrase.
words: HOW THIS PICTURE IS MADE   1 OF 3
PLACED BY: one shader, every frame
HOW THIS PICTURE IS MADE   2 OF 3
ITS COLOUR: = the position x, y, z
HOW THIS PICTURE IS MADE   3 OF 3
TOUCHDESIGNER   AUDIO VALUES TO THE SHADER
INSTANCING: 6144 COPIES OF ONE PAPER SHEET, EACH PLACED BY A SHADER.
RINGS OF PAPER TURN WITH THE BAR. THE BEAT FLIPS A RING TO BLUE.

as_processor: Prints the picture on every one of 6144 instanced paper sheets (and as a two-colour print on their reverses), then lays them as a floor or turns them in rings to the music; on the board take the wall of 96 x 64 sheets becomes a flip-dot display of the picture.
